dedupe_keys.name: gtfs plus transit network data standard for dynamic transit modelling

description: GTFS-Plus is a transit network data standard based on GTFS and designed for dynamic transit modelling, such as dynamic transit assignment. The specification repository gives version 0.4.1, created on 9 July 2015 and updated on 28 June 2017, with authors from the Puget Sound Regional Council, UrbanLabs LLC, LMZ LLC and the San Francisco County Transportation Authority. It adds files to GTFS, with the change log naming transfer, drive access point and fare attribute and rule files, first documented in technical memos of the Fast-Trips project. Coverage: any GTFS network. Format and access: a public specification. Licence and cost: Apache 2.0, free. Caveats: the standard has not been updated since 2017, and the README does not list supporting models. It supports network flow and agent-based transit models. It relates to the Dyno-Demand demand standard and the GTFS specification in the catalogue.
